records.text: Iran posed no imminent threat to the United States, and the war was started because of pressure from Israel and its powerful American lobby.
records.speaker: Joe Kent

appearances.snippet: I cannot in good conscience support the ongoing war in Iran. Iran posed no imminent threat to our nation, and it is clear that we started this war due to pressure from Israel and its powerful American lobby.

verification.notes: Kent's letter made both assertions. Public reporting documents an Israeli pressure campaign and quotes a senior senator saying no credible evidence of an imminent threat justified the war, while the White House and CIA publicly claimed contrary intelligence. The pressure component has reporting support; the categorical threat assessment remains disputed and classified evidence is unavailable.
